'''Vidunda''' (''Chividunda'') is a [[Bantu language]] spoken along the north bank of the Ruaha River in [[Tanzania]]. It belongs to the Ruvu branch of [[Northeast Coast Bantu]].<ref>Derek Nurse, 2003, ''The Bantu Languages''</ref>
